name: Lesbeon
look: a pink Eeveelution with a fierce red-eyed glare, a rainbow mohawk swept over one eye, tall pointed ears, two pink Venus-symbol earrings and a short spiky-tipped tail
entry: Two Eevee that love each other evolve together into Lesbeon. It stays fiercely loyal to its partner and protects her from anything, and the Venus marks that hang from its ears glow when the two are close.
how: Level up a female Eevee with another female Eevee in the party (the second evolves when it levels up with the first Lesbeon in the party). It learns Double Kick when it evolves.
